import_failed.title: The add-on's export could not be imported
import_failed.description:
Car Insights could not import the export of the Car Insights add-on, so it started with an empty database. The error was: {error}

The export file (/share/car_insights/export.db) is untouched. Fix the cause and restart Home Assistant to try again. The retry adds the export to the database: the car data received meanwhile is kept, but settings made in the meantime (prices, groups, viewers, costs) are not carried over.

cloud_entity_missing.title: {vehicle}: some car data is missing
cloud_entity_missing.description: Car Insights can no longer find these entities of {vehicle}: {readings}. They were probably removed or their integration was. Pick them again in Settings > Devices & services > Car Insights > Configure.

cloud_entity_missing_required.title: {vehicle}: Car Insights paused its cloud data
cloud_entity_missing_required.description: Car Insights can no longer find these entities of {vehicle}: {readings}. Without them it has paused reading this car's cloud data; nothing is lost, it catches up on up to 10 days once you pick them again in Settings > Devices & services > Car Insights > Configure.
